test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'HALT' is written as 'SZOG', and 'CROM' is written as 'XILN'. How will 'PIGY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768ffa75a91f088695c16a6deb50b713a526fcdb17ebb80961c20654cb850baa.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Opposite positional letters are written in place of the letters.**

 
• In HALT → SZOG 

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5489a444cd66ed357a29d51f7755f744dbfb16dcdf03379253f55addf18164cf.png] .​​​ 
 
 

 

 
• In CROM → XILN 

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66a9c9007031ce5c2e285b443c47a812075c354eaa3d48256df775a1e89a0ab0.png] .​​​ 
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, In PIGY → ? ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/522ab9900b50cb569b62451b5cb169d8cbc2280e49d4033871adedaa4a7fcc6a.png] 
 
 

We get 'KRTB'.

Hence, Option 3) is the correct answer.
